Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Represents a single financial transaction (income or expense).

amount.description: The amount of the transaction (positive for income, negative for expense).

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Represents a category for grouping transactions (e.g., 'Food', 'Rent', 'Salary').

isIncome.description: Indicates whether the category is for income (true) or expense (false).

Budget.title: Budget
Budget.description: Represents a monthly budget limit for a specific category.

categoryId.description: The ID of the category this budget applies to.

month.description: The month for which the budget is set, in YYYY-MM format.

limit.description: The budget limit for the category in that month.

/users/{userId}/categories/{categoryId}.description: Stores categories owned by a specific user.

/users/{userId}/budgets/{budgetId}.description: Stores budgets owned by a specific user.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Stores transactions owned by a specific user.
